verdict.rationale: Logseq is described as privacy-first and offline-first with local data, so users effectively control where data lives, for example on their own disk or synced through their own GitHub repo. However, its first-party Logseq Sync is documented only as end-to-end encrypted, with no region or residency choice, and one user notes there is no way to self-host it on their own server. Missing for 10: documented region/residency selection for Logseq Sync, first-party docs stating local storage location control, a self-hosted server option, and independent corroboration of residency controls.
